description: Connect all 35 frontend pages that use mock data to the real backend API using the existing useApi hook and api client
steps: Step 1: Update ALL listing pages under cadastros/ to replace mock data with real API calls. Each page must: (a) import useApi and useEffect from react, (b) call useApi with the correct endpoint (e.g., /cadastros/alunos, /cadastros/cursos, /cadastros/turmas, /cadastros/disciplinas, /cadastros/professores), (c) call execute() in useEffect, (d) render loading state, error state, and data from the API. Pages to update: cadastros/alunos/page.tsx, cadastros/cursos/page.tsx, cadastros/turmas/page.tsx, cadastros/disciplinas/page.tsx, cadastros/professores/page.tsx
Step 2: Update ALL listing pages under matriculas/ - same pattern as Step 1. Endpoint: /matriculas. Pages: matriculas/page.tsx

Step 3: Update ALL listing pages under notas/ - same pattern. Endpoints vary: /notas for main list, /notas/lancamento, /notas/alteracao, etc. Pages: notas/page.tsx, notas/lancamento/page.tsx, notas/alteracao/page.tsx, notas/fechamento/page.tsx, notas/historico/page.tsx, notas/boletins/page.tsx, notas/medias/page.tsx, notas/recuperacao/page.tsx
Step 4: Update ALL listing pages under diario/ - endpoints: /diario/chamadas, /diario/frequencia. Pages: diario/chamadas/page.tsx, diario/frequencia/page.tsx

Step 5: Update ALL listing pages under estagio/ - endpoints: /estagios, /estagios/empresas, /estagios/controle, /estagios/acompanhamento, /estagios/convenios. Pages: estagio/page.tsx, estagio/empresas/page.tsx, estagio/controle/page.tsx, estagio/acompanhamento/page.tsx, estagio/convenios/page.tsx

Step 6: Update ALL listing pages under financeiro/ - endpoints: /financeiro/contas-receber, /financeiro/mensalidades, /financeiro/parcelas, /financeiro/baixas, /financeiro/renegociacoes, /financeiro/fluxo, /financeiro/inadimplencia, /financeiro/[id]. Pages: financeiro/contas-receber/page.tsx, financeiro/mensalidades/page.tsx, financeiro/[id]/page.tsx, financeiro/parcelas/page.tsx, financeiro/baixas/page.tsx, financeiro/renegociacoes/page.tsx, financeiro/fluxo/page.tsx, financeiro/inadimplencia/page.tsx
Step 7: Update ALL listing pages under requerimentos/ and atas/ - endpoints: /requerimentos, /atas. Pages: requerimentos/page.tsx, atas/page.tsx

Step 8: Update remaining pages that use mock data: movimentacao/page.tsx, pesquisa/page.tsx, ajuda/page.tsx, janela/page.tsx - these may not have API endpoints, keep them as static/informational pages but remove fake mock data if present.

Step 9: Update the Dashboard page (dashboard)/page.tsx to fetch real KPI data from a /dashboard/stats endpoint (or keep hardcoded values but add a TODO comment noting this should be connected to real aggregation queries later).
Step 10: Add .env.local.example in src/frontend/ with NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:3001/api to document the required env var for frontend-backend connection.
acceptance_criteria: No pages import or reference mockAlunos, mockCursos, mockTurmas, or any mock* variables - they all use useApi or api.get
All listing pages show loading state while fetching
All listing pages show error message if API call fails
The DataTable component still receives data from the API response instead of static arrays

Run: cd /projects/sandbox/sistemamodelo/saas-educacional/src/frontend && npx next build (frontend compiles without type errors)
